training.dry_wet_pair: one dry and one randomly selected train wet condition, same song and crop each update
training.sampling: deterministic song/crop/wet-set from seed and step
training.scope: all 10578768 SCNet parameters; no refiner; no frozen teacher

loss.spectral: per-stem complex STFT RMSE using original SCNet STFT config; epsilon 1e-8 inside sqrt
loss.normalization: same mono mixture mean/std formula as official inference; target transformed by same inverse-compatible affine map

evaluation.primary: wet song-mean four-stem SI-SDR candidate-minus-initial_rev median
evaluation.selection: prefer passing primary and retention; otherwise report unaccepted candidate; within tier highest wet primary median
evaluation.deployment: requires separate comparison to existing ensemble including dry and vocals; no automatic adoption

limits: public backbone may have pretrained on validation songs
short-crop adaptation is not a replication of full paper training
